text: It helps get hang dry clothes done faster

I really like this product. It dried my intimates very fast and I put the bra in there soaking wet. Took me 5 mins to set up, the dryer gets hot : whew in that bag was like a sauna when I opened it, Sensational. I recommend this dryer for people who cannot afford a traditional dryer or would not purchase a dryer because it takes up a lot of room.

Awesome product really does work I have a washer and no dryer and produce a lot of laundry! Will heat up your house and even though it's electric it has no impact on the electric bill and I run this thing practically 24/7. It also survived being knocked over twice from a wind storm on my back porch. Worth the price thinking about buying a second. I also recommend buying baby hangers you can fit your clothing in it more easily and it creates extra space for additional hangers

For all the effort of setting it up and hanging my clothes in there, it dried them exactly as fast as hanging them outside would've done. Maybe useful in limited settings but really you're better off hanging your clothes on hangers in the bathroom and letting them drip dry.

I had doubts about this but let me say this works! I have it set up in my bathroom and this thing can make that room hot! I washed bedsheets and pillow cases and they were toasty in about an hour. I will try with other clothes but so far I am happy about how this works.

Update (10/27/16) Doing several loads and drying different types or clothes, this dryer has let me down a bit. I have let clothes dry with the maximum time 120 minutes, and there were some clothes that were still wet and did not feel warm at all. Most I spent was 4 hours trying to dry the same load of clothes and still had some wet spots. I will have to deduct a couple of stars for this. I don't want to spend the whole day drying the same clothes. It feels like the unit is throwing hot air but maybe the heats flow has a flaw.
This works great if you have silk like or very lightweight clothes. Anything thicker or cotton you need to run 2 full settings (over 200 min.) The good thing about this is it is very quiet.

This is a good product for someone that doesn't have the space or hookups for a standard clothes dryer. It does take a while to dry some heavier clothes such as hoodies or heavy jeans. I use this in an RV where I don't have enough room to dedicate space specially for a standard clothes dryer and it does well as long as I don't put to much in it. If you are using this in an RV or a small space just be ready for it to heat up the space surrounding it also, it will definitely overpower the 15k btu air conditioners in my RV. The only down side to it in my opinion is the drying time, it generally takes about two and a half to three hours to dry my jeans or hoodies but still does the job.
This works fantastically. Easy set up and break down. Stores in relatively small space.
It is perfect for me because I only have to dry several small pieces daily. And what beyond my expectation is that it can also serve as a heater and a humidifier at room~ (*≧▽≦)ﾉｼ)
Requires extra space around the item.

It has one flaw the air does not circulate the way it does in the picture, there fore the clothes get real stiff, adding EXTRA softener in the rinse cycle does help a little. It just needs some work on the blower.
I sent it back because I just didn't like it. It didn't dry as fast as I thought it would and it just wasn't worth the space it took.
This product does exactly what it is described to do. It works great on clothes! It's easy to put up, and easy to take down for storage. I absolutely love this dryer!!! Thank you!!!
Does the job it claims to do. Simple and easy from assembly to use.
Does not dry as well as I'd hoped, but does cut drying time on my jeans from a full day to a few hours, which makes it totally worth it for me.
It does a decent job but it is slow. OTOH, it is a heater inside a canvas; No one should expect it to be fast.

It is very easy to use and works well as long as I don't over pack it. I watched the videos and read the feedback before I bought it so I would understand how to use it. It is very easy to put together. It fits in my closet very well. A fantastic solution for a tiny apartment that has no hookups. Keeps me from going to the laundry mat. It is also quieter than a normal dryer - LOVE!

Ok so I ordered this dryer and I was so excited to use it BUT it didn't come with all the parts!!! I'm missing 2 of the legs to the dryer to help it stand up. I don't want to return it I just want the 2 legs! I'm so glad I opened the box! ALSO IT DIDNT COME WITH THE SHIPMENT INFORMATION TO RETURN IT!
not really impressed
As long as you do not over load it, it's great
Works well, I have found that it takes a while to dry if there is too much hung in it. But does it's job.
Dry your clothes without damaging them!  A dryer has a lint catch and in that is what was once a part of your clothes.  They are disintegrating.  Use this instead when you're not in a huge hurry.
It made my apartment feel like an oven and after four hours, my clothes were still damp.
Does not dry the clothes even after three hours. Returned it.

It takes too long to dry the cloth. One cycle of 180 minutes is not enough, maybe 360 minutes will do the job.
I was leaving the cloth hanging without the bag after the 180 minutes cycle, and 24 hours later it was dry.
The other issue is that it is bulky and warms up the place. I got it for drying delicate close but a regular dryer does a better job.
If there is no way to for you to get a regular dryer, then I recommend it.
Was kind of skeptical once i had it up and running this product made me a believer love it.
Excellent clothes dryer for items you do not put in the dryer. I love it!!

Great Product. Works much better than I expected. Also dried better than expected.
Very Pleased. Easy to Assemble.
It does dry cloths eventually, it would've been great if there were a softener product that could be use with this dryer, but I like the little space that it takes when drying and to store away.
This product works as expected. This is not a tumble dryer but more an accelerated hang dry system. It takes up small space and does what it advertises. Don't overload it would be my advice.

This dryer is amazing for small places like apts so easy to put together came super fast . Doesn't take as long to dry as I thought it would to dry towles and jeans I set it and  walk away and about hour a 20s I go back and check them if they need more time I give them more time to dry . I will be doing a review on the twin tub washwe in the next few days next .
Works just as expected. Love it!
So far so good.  All my hockey gear minus the skates fits in this thing and all I do is set for 60 min and my gear is bone dry and odor free

I bought both this pitcher and the [[ASIN:B0014X87ZM Cooper-Atkins 1236-70-1 Bi-Metals Espresso Milk Frothing Thermometer with Clip, 1" Dial and 5" Shaft Length]]. The thermometer fit the pitcher great!
This is great for frothing milk. I recommend this product.

Works great!

This is a great little pitcher. Perfect size for a couple of lattes for a home espresso machine. Cleans up well and is a great deal.

I love these X-Chef pitcher. Made sturdy and marks inside easy to see and very handy. One note I do own a few of these and not all come with measurement marking. Be sure if this important to read the description.
perfect

This is a good quality cup.  I would only mention that it is a bit smaller than I originally thought it would be.  It is 12 ounces but I would have sworn when I first saw it, it was only an 8 ounce cup.  Either way, it works.

Great little steaming cup. My only gripe is how small it is. It's good for one double latte, which is the size of a medium/grande latte at your local roasting spot. If you have two servings to make you will need to steam two batches. Otherwise, it's great.

I love this product

this is a beautifully made pitcher, very nicely finished.

[[VIDEOID:b35d0f419d2150d20dc242c308308ccf]] This really is a quality stainless steel pitcher.  I spend 7 years a restaurant manager and this is the quality I would have expected there.  It is nice and cleans very easily.  It has measurements on the inside which is very useful.  I just started making espresso at home about 3 weeks ago and this pitcher is perfect to make capaccino and lattes for my girlfriend.  It is easy to tell that it is a high quality of stainless by looking at it, but when you clean it, that fact becomes even more evident.  Everything just washes right out with water, no problem looks perfect, ready for the next day (and then run it through the dishwasher once a week).  Good piece of espresso eqipment.
at 10 oz, I thought it would be bigger, But it is well made and keeps milk cold and gravy hot. Great for the price!
Nice heft to the stainless steel.  Good quality.
perfect for what i needed

It's perfect to froth milk for a cup of latte.

nice!!

This is the perfect size for steaming a small amount of milk. Very happy with the quality of this frother.

10oz of frothed milk fills up my larger coffee mug or two or more espresso cups. Very well made and sturdy.. I love using this pitcher. If you do make drinks for more than 2 people or like larger than medium drinks, I would get a larger pitcher size.

Great little frothing pitcher. And I mean little... but it's exactly what I was looking for.

I purchased this pitcher and (Update International (EP-12) 12 Oz Stainless Steel Frothing Pitcher).

They both function the same and feel like they are both of equal quality. There is a price difference of $3.95, the X Chef being more money. I LOVE the measurements inside this pitcher! Even though its not a lot of liquid lost, it's still nice to not waste.
I bought this b/c I didn't want an aluminum product. This stainless steel frothing pitcher looks great when washed and is solid in construction. I'd buy this again.
lot smaller than expected. they are good aside from that

very useful, cleans good.

Works just as I expected. I like how the measuring lines are inside the cup to keep my drink measured properly. Depending on the size coffee you like, you may want to get the 12oz cup (I have the 10oz). It does work perfect for what I use it for though :)

This is the perfect pitcher for SMALL milk-based drinks. The 10oz size is great for Macchiatos, Cortados, and Flat Whites. I have a 20oz pitcher as well, but it's impossible to froth only 4 oz of milk, because the base of the pitcher is so wide (you can't submerge the steam wand down in the milk). This pitcher easily handles small volumes of milk and the markings help keep waste down. The spout is also really nice for pouring latte art. Feels very sturdy as well. Highly recommended. I bought this freezer last December. I had no complaints with it until it stopped working, defrosting all of the food inside. After rescuing as much as I could I set out trying to get someone to repair the unit, as it comes with a one year warranty. The first thing I discovered was the warranty information here on Amazon is not correct. This item is not warrantied by GE, but rather by a third party corporation known as Curtis International which warranties all of Igloo's products.

Curtis International's website:[...] States that they have 24/7 product support. This isn't true because the first six times I called the phone tree dumped me into a queue and then I was disconnected with a message to call later at a time convenient to me. Um, I'm calling now because THIS is a time convenient to me. When I finally got through the person on the other end was difficult to understand, and after much repeating he asked me questions like "Is the lid closed securely" and then told me to reset the system "By turning it to lo and then high 6-7 seven times" I followed all of his supposed reset instructions (which, by the way, aren't in my user manual and felt like a delaying tactic) and surprise!
